pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck are larger and more elongated, while those on the mid-flank and hindquarters are smaller, more condensed, and exhibit higher spatial frequency.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathway thickness is consistently narrow with high continuity across the visible torso.
